invented.quote: The market has moved as well.
invented.why: The brief gives the current standard range for an illustrator with her record and a fee from another publisher, but does not state whether overall market rates have changed over time.

invented.quote: Last year another publisher paid me $12,500 for a 32-page book of the same scope.
invented.why: The brief says the other publisher's book was of the "same length" (32 pages), not the "same scope" (such as also having about 14 full spreads).
